services.title: Small Business Insurance
services.text: Property, liability and workers' compensation for small businesses, written to protect assets, control losses and lower the total cost of risk.
services.lead: Small businesses are critical to local economies, and they need comprehensive coverages to protect their assets, control losses and build a foundation for success. Running a small business in a rural area can come with its own unique challenges.
services.imageAlt: A small storefront on a quiet street

covers.title: General liability
covers.text: Protects a business from bodily injuries, advertising injuries and customer property damage. Many commercial leases require it.

covers.title: Commercial property
covers.text: Safeguards a business's physical structure and its contents, including furniture, equipment and inventory.

covers.title: Business Owner's Policy
covers.text: A BOP bundles commercial property and general liability under one plan and can be a cost-effective option for a small business.

covers.title: Business income
covers.text: Also called business interruption insurance. It compensates for income lost because of property damage.

covers.title: Workers' compensation
covers.text: Addresses the costs when an employee becomes injured or ill on the job.

covers.title: Cyber and professional liability
covers.text: Cyber liability for a data breach, and errors and omissions coverage for claims about work performance.

questions.q: Why does a small business need these coverages?
questions.a: Without insurance, owners may have to pay for damages out of pocket. Coverage matters for complying with government regulations or landlord policies, responding to workers' compensation claims, standing behind the business and its employees in a lawsuit, and managing costs after a natural disaster, vandalism or theft.

questions.q: What does working with us look like?
questions.a: We offer brokerage services to help small businesses mitigate risk and protect their assets, starting with a needs assessment and continuing with ongoing support.

services.text: Carrying the right commercial coverage reduces your total cost of risk. We work to understand all aspects of your business and place the program through the best markets available.
services.lead: As a business owner in any industry, you face exposure to various hazards that can jeopardize your company. We strive to understand all aspects of your business, develop a coverage plan for all contingencies and find coverage through the best insurance markets available.
services.imageAlt: A white work truck parked behind a chain-link fence

covers.title: General liability
covers.text: Helps cover claims that may arise during normal business operations.

covers.title: Workers' compensation
covers.text: Pays claims resulting from workplace accidents and injuries.

covers.title: Commercial auto
covers.text: Covers the vehicles your business owns and operates.

covers.title: Commercial umbrella

covers.title: Cyber insurance

services.title: Management and Professional Liability
services.summary: Cover for directors, officers and managers.
services.text: Professional liability insurance helps protect a business and its directors, officers and managers from the wide range of exposures they face, whether the company is public, private or non-profit.
services.lead: Whether your company is public, private or non-profit, the individuals in charge of its direction and performance make daily decisions that can adversely affect your company, regardless of intent. Professional liability insurance helps protect businesses and their directors, officers and managers from the wide range of exposures they face.

covers.title: Directors and officers liability
covers.text: Securities claims, wrongful acts and the defence costs that follow, which can be expensive on their own whether or not an individual is ultimately held liable.

covers.title: Employment practices liability
covers.text: Claims about wrongful employment practices, covering the cost to defend an employment claim.

covers.title: Errors and omissions

covers.title: Fiduciary, crime and network risks

covers.title: Umbrella insurance

covers.title: Program design
covers.text: We start with your business — its history, industry, customers, structure, ownership, management, products, services and financial picture — then work with underwriters to develop coverage options that fit.

questions.q: Is this risk already covered by our general liability or umbrella policy?
questions.a: It is a common misconception that protection for this type of risk is found in other areas of a company's insurance program, such as general liability and umbrella policies. A management and professional liability program is designed and implemented separately.

questions.q: Where do these claims come from?
questions.a: Customers, competitors, suppliers, employees, shareholders and government regulators.

services.lead: Offering 401(k) plans and retirement consulting for employees can be an excellent way to support employee welfare. The retirement planning process requires extensive foresight and an acute awareness of financial strategy, and relying on experienced consultants can help employers develop a comprehensive plan designed for risk mitigation and financial optimization.

covers.title: Choosing a plan

covers.title: Compliance

questions.a: A 401(k) is a retirement plan sponsored by an employer that employees can contribute to through a tax-free paycheck deduction, which the employer matches with a pre-tax contribution. Group 401(k) plans have higher contribution caps than other retirement funds.

questions.q: Why is retirement planning worth offering?
questions.a: For employees, long-term investing through a manageable payroll deduction secures a financial future. For employers, the benefit makes the company more competitive in the labor market and can improve morale and overall work performance.

questions.q: How does a surety bond work?
questions.a: A surety bond is a three-party guarantee. The principal is you or your business, promising to fulfill an obligation. The obligee is the entity that requires the bond. The surety is the insurance company that guarantees to the obligee that the principal will fulfill the obligation.

questions.q: How do I get a surety bond in Texas?
questions.a: Start by confirming the bond form, the required amount and the deadline, then submit your application and supporting information for underwriting.

questions.q: How much does a surety bond cost?
questions.a: You pay a premium, often a small percentage of the bond amount, rather than the full bond amount.

questions.q: Is a surety bond the same as insurance?
questions.a: No. If the surety pays a claim, the principal is ultimately responsible for reimbursing the surety for the amount paid.

questions.q: Which industries does BMBRisk work in?

Our knowledge of the industry lets us compare products to find a cost-effective service customized to your company.

We have experience outsourcing a wide array of services, including payroll support, benefits and workers' compensation.

about.title: Allsurance Agency, a division of Bowen, Miclette & Britt.
text: Allsurance Agency has teamed up with Bowen, Miclette & Britt. We are excited to continue providing Dayton and the surrounding communities with the knowledge, vision, accountability and service that BMB has exemplified for more than 40 years.

At Allsurance Agency, a division of BMB, we understand the needs of small businesses in Texas and are committed to finding them the insurance coverage needed to lower their total cost of risk. We offer a wide range of insurance options, including property, liability and workers' compensation, to protect businesses from the unexpected.

One of the key benefits of working with Allsurance and BMB is our personalized approach to insurance. We take the time to get to know each business and their specific needs, so we can tailor a policy that fits their unique situation.

Recognized as one of the largest independent insurance agencies in America, BMB has large-agency capabilities while maintaining small-agency service and values. BMB's clients span all industries, including construction, energy, manufacturing and general industry.

faqs.a: No. Completion of a request for information does not constitute the purchase of insurance. No coverage may be added, changed or bound as a result of submitting a request for information or a quotation. All coverage must be confirmed by the agency in writing, subject to an acceptable signed application meeting the underwriting guidelines of the insurance company.
